lesson.title: Procedure 502 – Caller Request to Remain Anonymous
objectives: Identify how to recognize and handle anonymity requests (anon box/remarks).
Limit disclosure of caller identity over the air per Procedure 502.
Apply the emergency categories where ANI/ALI may be transmitted over the air.
Apply prohibitions and alternatives (narcotics restriction, phone caller, landline).
Follow special handling for Block Watchers and State Mental Hospital incidents.
Apply supervisor verification requirements before over-air ANI/ALI transmission.
